alt: Apple Mac mini M4 desktop computer photographed at an angle showing its front USB-C ports and the bottom face of the device, where the power button is hidden from normal view
story: Apple's Mac mini M4 (launched late 2024) has its power button recessed on the underside of the device, requiring users to flip their computer upside-down to press it; Apple defended the choice saying users 'hardly ever' need the physical button, until macOS 26.5 added a keyboard shortcut workaround in May 2026.
why_funny: Apple charged up to 1,399 USD for a desktop computer and hid the on/off button where no one can see or reach it without turning the whole machine upside-down — then justified this by saying nobody uses it anyway.
